summary: Iteration 5: Full end-to-end verification of Odyssey's Wrath post-AI-removal. Backend verified (GET /api/ 200, POST /api/npc/chat and /api/battle/enemy-action both 404 as expected). Frontend fully traversed: Title -> story skip (ESC during typing) -> Hollow Village zone banner -> scripted Theron dialogue (speaker + text + 4 choices) -> M1 left-click killed Spineback Lurker (HP 28 -> killed) -> explore death (hp=0) respawned at village spawn (5,10) with cutscene text 'You collapsed... and woke where you started.' -> battle trigger reached (sliding collision + wider zone works) -> boss-bar appeared immediately on battle start -> fast-forward timer -> Death Recap (grade shown) -> Chapter II interlude -> Ravine Floor with Orin scripted dialogue + killable enemies -> ravine exit -> Cliffgate -> Vael scripted dialogue -> Eastern Gate exit (24,7) -> ending-screen with 'To Be Continued...' title (ending-screen-title) -> ending-screen-continue click returned to ODYSSEY'S WRATH title screen. Network sniffer confirmed ZERO calls to /api/npc/chat or /api/battle/enemy-action during the full playthrough.

integration_issues.issue: During a 20-second passive observation of the Kairen battle (no player attacks), neither the qte-overlay element nor a Kairen taunt dialogue were observed. window.__odyssey.qteActive remained false and lastQteSequence was unchanged. Main agent previously verified QTEs trigger with active play, so this may simply be because the player did not initiate attacks (QTEs are telegraphed on boss attack cycles). Flag for main agent to confirm QTEs fire within ~5-10s of battle start regardless of player action, otherwise players who stand still may see no QTE at all.

integration_issues.flow: Reputation display update on Kind choice
integration_issues.issue: After selecting the [Kind] choice with Theron, the reputation-display still read 'UNKNOWN' and window.__odyssey.combatStats.reputation was null. The task says Kind should raise reputation by +2 and the display should change. Either reputation is stored elsewhere (not combatStats.reputation) or the +2 is below the threshold to flip the label from UNKNOWN. Please verify.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Full happy path end-to-end validated in iteration 5. The two remaining uncertainties are (1) whether reputation display actually ticks when a Kind dialogue choice is selected (observed UNKNOWN before and after) and (2) whether QTEs appear automatically in battle without player attacks. Both are low/medium priority. Everything else (title->story->village->battle->death recap->interlude->ravine->cliffgate->ending->play again) works, and the backend AI endpoints are correctly removed (404). Use window.__odyssey + held-key steering (w/s/a/d combos per isometric mapping) for navigation automation.
